title: Play AC Online mod items file
description: New furniture, each on a vanilla base piece. The game also refuses a base with no model, fossils, gyroids, clothing, design pieces and pieces a player carries as an item: umbrellas, fish, bugs, tools, balloons, fans, pinwheels and diaries. In the save, a mod item is its base piece. A file beside the save (mod-items.json) maps it back. Removing the mod therefore leaves the base piece behind, and reinstalling restores the mod item. That file belongs to the save it was written beside. Next to another save of the same town, such as a backup put back or an older town file imported, it is not used. Those pieces are then plain base pieces again. An item may carry its own pictures ("textures"). They replace the base piece's textures on that item alone, in a house and on Nook's floor. On the flower shop's bench a furniture good is a leaf. Every other copy of the base keeps its look. Generated from the mod API spec (https://playaconline.com/schemas/api.json). Do not edit by hand. Reference: https://playaconline.com/modding/reference/files/#items

id.description: The item's own id. Its full id is <mod id>:<id>.

name.description: 1 to 16 characters: letters, digits, space and ' . , ! & -. It starts with a letter or digit and does not end with a space.

base.description: A south-facing furniture id: 0x1000 to 0x1FFC or 0x3000 to 0x33C4, a multiple of 4.

price.description: The price in Bells. Leave it out for the base piece's price.

textures.description: A folder inside the mod with this item's own pictures: 1 to 16 .png or .dds files named like a texture mod's files, with the base piece's texture names. Only this item draws them. The folder may not be inside content.textures or hold it.

items.description: The new items. Each one stands on a base piece of the game's own furniture.
